title: Meet Specter: ABM account scoring that shows its work
summary: Specter puts every ABM target account in a buying stage, shows the reason behind it, and names the people driving it. See how it works and how it was tested.
body_markdown:
Legacy ABM platforms


Hand-weighted models


Asking an LLM


Specter


What it sees


Account-level research intent and website activity


Firmographic fit and the engagement you already know about


Whatever you give it, one account at a time


Real buyer journeys, plus calls, emails and your custom signals


Shows its work


Surges often trace to one person, and the score looks the same either way


Yes. You know why it scored a 72 because you set the points


Push back on the answer and it may simply agree


Every stage comes with its reason and the people behind it


The tradeoff


Reps are left to work out who’s behind a surge


Weights set and re-tuned by hand; fit and intent blended


Labels drift across a list; stable answers mean babysitting prompts


Learns weights from real journeys, keeps fit and intent separate, re-scores daily
